name: Hue Shift
description: Shifts the hue of all level objects except icons and portals/speed portals.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable or disable the hue shift effect.

hue-shift.name: Hue Shift
hue-shift.description: Amount of hue shift in degrees (0-360).

shift-bg.name: Shift Background
shift-bg.description: Also shift the hue of the background color.

shift-ground.name: Shift Ground
shift-ground.description: Also shift the hue of the ground color.
